name: @vue-migrate/plugin-v-model-emit-fixer
description: Fix Vue 2 style `emit('input', ...)` to Vue 3 `emit('update:modelValue', ...)` in <script setup>. Resolves P1 #15 (v-model on children like FilenameOption, AutoWidthOption, BookTypeOption, Upload, MarkdownEditor, Tinymce, JsonEditor, ImageCropper, MDinput, Dropdown components).
